title: Corpus fleet universal identity graph contract
rules: Every identity edge is an assertion with provenance.
Catalogue labels are not physical-object identifiers unless the source establishes that relation.
Matching strings, adjacent catalogue numbers, shared coordinates, visual resemblance or inherited digital links never create CERTAIN identity automatically.
One physical object may bear multiple texts or surfaces and one text may have multiple edition assertions.
Parent or suffix catalogue relations do not imply physical part-whole relations without evidence.
Rejected and disputed identity assertions remain queryable rather than being deleted.
cross_corpus_rule: Identity interoperability never implies linguistic relationship, sign equivalence, chronology, borrowing or decipherment.
